The Chaos Mesh Dashboard API provides HTTP REST endpoints for managing chaos engineering experiments on Kubernetes. The API is served by the chaos-dashboard component on port 2333 by default and is used by the Chaos Dashboard web UI as well as automation integrations. It supports full lifecycle management of chaos experiments (PodChaos, NetworkChaos, IOChaos, StressChaos, HTTPChaos, TimeChaos, and others), workflows for orchestrating experiments in serial or parallel, schedules for recurring experiments using cron expressions, event history, and experiment archives. The API interacts with the Kubernetes API server to create and manage Chaos Mesh custom resources.
